title: Lumentum buys optical transceiver maker Cloud Light for $750M

sources.quote: Under terms of the merger agreement, Lumentum acquired Cloud Light with a transaction value of approximately $750 million, before certain adjustments.

explain: Lumentum paid about $750 million in cash for Cloud Light, a Hong Kong-based maker of optical transceivers (the plug-in modules that turn electrical signals into light) used inside AI data centers. Announced in October 2023 and closed in November 2023.
